name: C.D. Besadny Conservation Fund
summary: Annual small grants for conservation and education projects that benefit Wisconsin's lands, waters and wildlife, with priority for imperiled species and natural communities and climate resilience.

eligibility.rule: Be a 501(c)(3) charity of a listed 509(a) type, federal/state/local government, tribe, or accredited college/university
Not be an individual, business, Type III supporting organization, private foundation, or private operating foundation
Keep the total project budget at or below $25,000
Submit no more than one application per organization per grant cycle

calls.label: Annual round
calls.recurring: Applications due each year by 1 September

status.quote: Submit all materials to NRFgrants@WisConservation.org by September 1st.

recurring.quote: Submit all materials to NRFgrants@WisConservation.org by September 1st.

applicant_types.quote: Applicant must be one of the following: a public charity with approved 501(c)(3) exempt status (under section 509(a)(1), 509(a)(2), or 509(a)(3) Type I and Type II); a federal, state, or local governmental unit, an American Indian nation or tribal community; or an accredited college or university.

geography.quote: conservation and education projects that benefit Wisconsin's lands, waters, and wildlife

access.quote: Complete the application (paper copies of applications are not accepted).

window.quote: Submit all materials to NRFgrants@WisConservation.org by September 1st.

co_finance_required.quote: A one-to-one match is encouraged, but not required. Match may include in-kind support such as volunteer hours or donated materials.

effort.quote: Complete the application (paper copies of applications are not accepted). Submit all materials to NRFgrants@WisConservation.org by September 1st.

eligibility.quote: Applicant must be one of the following: a public charity with approved 501(c)(3) exempt status (under section 509(a)(1), 509(a)(2), or 509(a)(3) Type I and Type II); a federal, state, or local governmental unit, an American Indian nation or tribal community; or an accredited college or university.

The following types of organizations are not eligible for funding: individuals; businesses; section 509(a)(3) Type III supporting organizations; private foundations; and private operating foundations.
The total project budget may not exceed $25,000
Only one application will be accepted per organization per grant cycle.

after_award.quote: I understand that if I am awarded a grant, I will be asked to submit a grant report within one year.

documents.quote: I have included the project budget (using either the template provided, or another document that works best for my project).
